# Resource tools

6 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `read_resource`

Load a Godot resource file (.tres, .res, or any ResourceLoader-supported path) and return all its stored properties. Use this to inspect a resource before editing it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `resource_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the resource file, e.g. 'res://data/my.tres' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/18-resource.json`, test RS-02:

```json
{
  "resource_path": "res://test_res.tres"
}
```

## `edit_resource`

Modify one or more properties of an existing resource file and save it to disk. Property values are type-coerced to match the resource's declared property types. Call read_resource first to see available property names and their current values.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `resource_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the resource file to modify |
| `properties` | `object` | yes | Dict mapping property names to new values. Supports bool, int, float, string, Vector2/3 as [x,y]/[x,y,z] arrays or {x,y}/{x,y,z} dicts, Color as [r,g,b,a] or hex string, resource paths starting with 'res://'. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/18-resource.json`, test RS-03:

```json
{
  "resource_path": "res://test_res.tres",
  "properties": {
    "resource_name": "MCPTestResource"
  }
}
```

## `create_resource`

Create a new instance of any Godot ClassDB resource type and save it as a .tres file. The class must be a Resource subclass registered in ClassDB (e.g. 'Environment', 'AudioStreamWAV', 'StyleBoxFlat', 'Resource').

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `resource_class` | `string` | yes | Godot class name to instantiate, e.g. 'Environment', 'AudioStreamWAV', 'StyleBoxFlat', 'Resource' |
| `resource_path` | `string` | yes | Destination path for the .tres file, e.g. 'res://data/my_env.tres' |
| `properties` | `object` | — | Optional initial property values to set before saving |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` | — | Replace an existing file at resource_path. Defaults to false. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/18-resource.json`, test RS-01:

```json
{
  "resource_class": "Resource",
  "resource_path": "res://test_res.tres",
  "overwrite": true
}
```

## `save_resource`

Load a resource and re-save it. When dest_path is omitted, force-resaves to the same path (useful to upgrade resource format or flush pending changes). When dest_path is provided, copies/converts the resource to that path.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `source_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the resource to load and save |
| `dest_path` | `string` | — | Optional destination path. If omitted, saves back to source_path. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/18-resource.json`, test RS-04:

```json
{
  "source_path": "res://test_res.tres"
}
```

## `get_project_autoloads`

Return all autoload singletons registered in the project settings (reads ProjectSettings). Each entry includes name, script/scene path, and whether it is instantiated as a node. Use set_autoload to add or remove entries.

Takes no parameters.

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/18-resource.json`, test RS-05:

```json
{}
```

## `set_autoload`

Add, update, or remove an autoload singleton in the project settings. Changes take effect in the editor immediately. Use action 'remove' to delete an existing autoload; action 'add' (default) to add or overwrite one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | Autoload singleton name (must be a valid GDScript identifier, e.g. 'GameManager') |
| `action` | `string` | — | 'add' (default) adds or updates the autoload; 'modify' is an alias for 'add'; 'remove' deletes the autoload entry. One of: `"add"`, `"modify"`, `"remove"`. |
| `path` | `string` | — | Path to the script or scene file to autoload, e.g. 'res://scripts/game_manager.gd'. Required when action is 'add' or 'modify'. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/18-resource.json`, test RS-06:

```json
{
  "action": "add",
  "name": "MCPTestAutoload",
  "path": "res://tests/test_example.gd"
}
```
